description: Day 6 was about trusting the model's account of what a tool printed. Today there is no tool. The model answers from memory: what it learned in training. **That memory stops at a cut-off date, and the model doesn't mark…
line: Model states a training-time fact as current, with no date ("pinned requests==2.31.0, latest stable" when PyPI has 2.34.2 and 2.31.0 has three known advisories)
title: Day 7 — Stale Certainty
